column1: # Bundled price seed for Kimi Code models — the lowest-precedence rate source.
# Config (RTC_PRICE_*) wins, then the models.dev cache written by `rtc rates`,
# then this. Rates are $ per million tokens: input, cache_read, cache_write,
# output. Only models with a published first-party price belong here — a model
# nobody sells by the token gets no invented number. The bundle date is the
# freshness bound; the render path self-refreshes the cache past it.
